title: Crab dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow/lit contact -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='26' ry='4' fill='#274a63'/>
  <!-- legs (left) -->
  <path d='M34 66 L22 72 L16 66' stroke='#ff7a3d' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M36 72 L26 80 L20 74' stroke='#ff7a3d' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- legs (right) -->
  <path d='M66 66 L78 72 L84 66' stroke='#ff7a3d' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M64 72 L74 80 L80 74' stroke='#ff7a3d' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- raised dancing claw + arm (left) -->
  <path d='M30 54 L18 44' stroke='#ff4d4d' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='14' cy='40' rx='9' ry='7' transform='rotate(-25 14 40)' fill='#ff4d4d'/>
  <path d='M10 35 L16 32 M19 33 L13 30' stroke='#ffb3a0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- lowered claw + arm (right) -->
  <path d='M70 56 L82 62' stroke='#ff4d4d' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='87' cy='64' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#ff4d4d'/>
  <path d='M91 59 L95 62 M90 67 L95 65' stroke='#ffb3a0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body shell -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='24' ry='19' fill='#ff5a3c'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='18' ry='11' fill='#ff8a5c'/>
  <!-- shell spots -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#ffd0a8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#ffd0a8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='68' r='2.5' fill='#ffd0a8'/>
  <!-- eyes on stalks -->
  <path d='M42 46 L39 36' stroke='#ff7a3d' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 46 L61 36' stroke='#ff7a3d' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='33' r='6' fill='#fff3e0'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='33' r='6' fill='#fff3e0'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='34' r='3' fill='#22303f'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='34' r='3' fill='#22303f'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='32' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='32' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- happy mouth -->
  <path d='M44 52 Q50 58 56 52' stroke='#c93a1e' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- dancing sparkles -->
  <path d='M20 22 L22 28 L28 30 L22 32 L20 38 L18 32 L12 30 L18 28 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M80 18 L81.5 22 L86 23.5 L81.5 25 L80 29 L78.5 25 L74 23.5 L78.5 22 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
